blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David has been conferred an honorary Doctor of Humanities (Honoris Causa) degree by De La Salle Araneta University (DLSAU) for his contributions to pastoral leadership and social justice, according to the university. David received the award on Saturday during the university’s commencement exercises. READ: Cardinal David’s new book shows Jesus’ ‘humanity and compassion’ “This distinction recognizes Cardinal David’s outstanding contributions to biblical scholarship, pastoral leadership, social justice advocacy, and the promotion of human dignity,” the DLSAU wrote in a Facebook post.
